From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@forrester.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 14:07:00 -0400
Subject: Forrester request: NorthBay Health on production inference topic

Hi Evelyn —

I'm Sophie Martin, principal analyst covering AI operations at Forrester. We're putting together a short set of briefing calls for an upcoming vendor landscape note on production inference economics and reliability. NorthBay Health came up as a strong example of a healthcare org running Redwood Inference in production.

Would NorthBay be willing to do a 30-minute reference call (analyst + vendor + customer) to discuss: deployment model used, latency/throughput targets, cost controls (batching/caching/quantization), and compliance (data residency, audit logs)? We schedule these as 30-minute remote calls; we can do a recording if useful.

Before scheduling, I need: 
- A contact who can speak to technical/ops details (devops/ML infra) and one who can speak to procurement/compliance if relevant
- Confirmation that the customer is comfortable speaking with Forrester (written consent is fine)
- Any NDA/contract language required for participation (we can sign a short consent form)

Proposed windows next week: Tue 6/29 10:30–12:30 ET or Wed 6/30 14:00–17:00 ET. If neither works, suggest alternatives.

Thanks — appreciate the intro.

Best,
Sophie Martin
Principal Analyst, AI Operations
Forrester Research
Sophie.martin@forrester.com

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for reaching out. Happy to coordinate. Looping in Karthik (advocacy) and Marissa (customer success) to confirm customer contacts and logistics.

High level: NorthBay's technical lead is Liam O'Neill (liam.oneill@northbayhealth.com) — he can speak to ops and performance. I'll ask Marissa to surface a procurement/compliance point of contact if needed.

We can do Wed 6/30 14:00–14:30 ET (that maps to 11:00 PT for us) — Karthik/Marissa, can you confirm?

Two quick notes for the briefing prep: 
- NorthBay prefers a short consent email rather than an NDA in most cases; however procurement has required an NDA in the past for analyst recordings. Please confirm if Forrester requires a signed NDA or if a consent-only workflow is acceptable.
- If the ask includes sensitive metrics (P95 latency, P50 cost per inference tied to revenue data), NorthBay will likely want those surfaced as ranges or redacted. Please confirm the specificity Forrester expects.

I've attached a draft agenda we typically use for analyst calls.
